supportingSources.supports: Guessing may simultaneously grant healing and a random basic card. All four basic names may be selected; unselected names mean absent. A handless target is legal and selecting no names is completely correct. The source must discard a hand card if able; an actual Slash discard gives the owner one draw.

rules.deru: One activation per actual Play phase; compare four presence bits for Slash/Dodge/Peach/Alcohol. At least one matching presence/absence heals 1, any mismatch obtains one random eligible current basic hand entity, and exact set equality draws up to current HP after the earlier native children finish. Empty guesses and empty target hands remain legal.
rules.identity: Native actual entity identity uses AdvancedEffectiveHandKind, which includes actual cardIdentities and excludes optional viewAs conversions. ProgramBasicCardName merges the complete native Slash family. Guess results and pre-payment take/discard effective names are frozen before health or movement children can remove a skill or change a card zone.
rules.linjie: One mandatory resolution per actual damage instance. Its exact living damage source privately chooses one discardable hand card; source-less damage, a dead source or no eligible hand card has no cost or reward. Only the actual chosen effective Slash hand entity rewards one draw after its real discard children return.
rules.privacy: All 16 Deru guesses are always privately offered, independent of the hidden target hand. The actual hand-name mask, random candidate collection and random index remain solely on the owning typed frame. Linjie card choices belong only to the source. Public custom events contain scalar start/step/completion receipts and no hidden guess masks or unselected card IDs.
rules.continuations: Confirmed Deru results and paid Linjie discard survive skill loss and drain native health/movement/recovery/dying children once. Owner death drains issued children and terminates unperformed benefits. Native random state is checkpointed and no resumed step draws random numbers or pays the same movement twice.
